patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics, and on NPS, Mapbox's map usage reports. Every app feature is left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops NPS from scanning for Bluetooth beacons in parks, which can tell the app where in a park you are. Content tied to a beacon at a park site does not show. Opt-in; test on-device.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
